==Description==
'''Necropolis''' is a night-time [[Maps|map]] that takes place in a haunted graveyard.

==Design & Path==
'''Necropolis''' takes place in a haunted graveyard that is surrounded by mountains. Multiple gravestones are scattered across the map, some of them having green cracks or green ghosts come out from them. Multiple stone statues can be found on the map. Multiple cliffs and trees can also be seen on the map, with one of the trees being a large, green, translucent tree. Additionally, multiple fences and metal lanterns can be seen on the map.

The path starts at an open coffin and ends at a cave. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding cliffs present on the map.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Necropolis}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*Since this map has a decent amount of cliff spots, towers such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Mortar]] can be very effective.
**You can pair these towers with a [[DJ Booth]] to maximize the efficiency of their range.
*Ground towers generally be placed near the large green tree, as it allows towers to maximize their path coverage.
**Do note that because of the length of the path, it will take enemies some time to get there, especially slower ones. It also allows summoner enemies, like the [[Molten Summoner]] to spawn a lot of enemies.
***Because of this, in some cases it may be better to place your tower at the entrance.
